name: Accordion
summary: Vertical disclosure group with contextual headings, native triggers, truly hidden collapsed panels, optional indicators, per-item disabled state, and target-coordinated expansion.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: Vertical wrapper around one or more disclosure items.

anatomy.name: heading
anatomy.description: Contextual native or ARIA heading whose only child is the trigger.

anatomy.name: trigger
anatomy.description: Native Button that toggles one associated panel.

anatomy.name: icon
anatomy.description: Optional decorative expansion indicator supplied by the consumer or target.

anatomy.name: panel
anatomy.description: Panel container linked to its trigger and hidden when collapsed; region semantics are contextual.

anatomy.name: panelInner
anatomy.description: Optional compatibility wrapper that does not own visibility or accessibility semantics.

anatomy.name: content
anatomy.description: Consumer-owned flow content inside the panel.

sizes.name: default
sizes.description: Default Accordion trigger and content spacing.

states.name: collapsed
states.description: Collapsed trigger state with its panel removed from rendering and focus order.

states.name: expanded
states.description: Expanded trigger exposes its associated visible panel.

states.name: iconExpanded
states.description: Optional indicator rotates to communicate expanded state.

states.name: hover
states.description: Pointer hover state on an enabled trigger.

states.name: focusVisible
states.description: Keyboard focus indicator on the trigger.

states.name: disabled
states.description: Unavailable item trigger cannot change expansion state.

behavior.name: headingSemantics
behavior.description: Each native Button trigger is the only child of a heading whose level fits the containing page hierarchy.

behavior.name: disclosureSemantics
behavior.description: Trigger and panel ids, expanded state, optional region label, and native hidden state remain synchronized.

behavior.name: toggle
behavior.description: Activating an enabled native trigger requests the opposite per-item expanded state.

behavior.name: panelVisibility
behavior.description: Collapsed panels are not rendered, announced, or included in sequential focus; visual-only zero-height collapse is insufficient.

behavior.name: groupPolicy
behavior.description: Consumers or target adapters coordinate single, multiple, or exact-exclusive groups without changing per-item semantics.

behavior.name: optionalRegion
behavior.description: Use a labelled region only when the panel is structurally significant; avoid landmark proliferation in large groups.

behavior.name: disabledItem
behavior.description: A disabled item remains perceivable but cannot be toggled by pointer or keyboard.

properties.name: items
properties.description: One or more repeated heading, trigger, panel, and content item compositions.

properties.name: expanded
properties.description: Controls the expanded state of an individual item; target groups may coordinate multiple item states.

properties.name: disabled
properties.description: Makes an individual item trigger unavailable without hiding its heading.

accessibility: Wrap each native Button trigger in a contextual heading and keep the trigger as its only child.
Synchronize aria-expanded, aria-controls, stable ids, and native hidden panel state.
Support native click, Enter, and Space activation while preserving normal Tab order.
Use role="region" only when it adds useful structure and will not create landmark proliferation.
Ensure collapsed panels and their interactive descendants are absent from rendering and sequential focus.

web.notes: Canonical CSS styles APG disclosure markup; a target may alternatively map to native details/summary while preserving the visual classes and state contract.

shopify.notes: Liquid can emit APG Button markup or native details; theme behavior owns optional group coordination.
